Definition: to cut or split in two; to halve
BiblicalUsage: To divide is to cut in two, and the word marks the turning points of the story. Jacob divides his household into two bands before meeting Esau, Elijah's mantle divides the Jordan, Gideon divides three hundred men into three companies, and Moses commands the prey of Midian to be divided in two.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God works through divisions that men make in fear and faith alike. Jacob divided out of fear, Elijah out of power, and God honoured both, because He is the one who parts the waters.
RelatedEvents: Jacob Meets Esau Again; Elijah Taken Up in a Chariot of Fire; Gideon's Victory over Midian; War against Midian
